comment: This is VCV's own MIDI-CV with an MTS-ESP client added. The retuning is applied in semitones on top of the MIDI note number (MIDI_CV_MTS_ESP.cpp:99-102), so the pitch output follows the master's tuning while a note is held unless the note-on-only menu item is set. A note the master filters out is skipped before the parser sees it (lines 79-83), so no gate is produced for it either.
